# GitHub Streak Stats

> Free, open-source (MIT) web tool that shows a GitHub user's current contribution streak, longest streak and total contributions, and generates an SVG streak card to embed in a GitHub README. No account needed.

## How it works

- Data comes from the GitHub contribution calendar through the GitHub GraphQL API.
- A streak is a run of consecutive UTC calendar days with at least one contribution. If today has none yet, a streak that reached yesterday still counts as current.
- Private contributions are counted only when the user enables "Include private contributions on my profile" on GitHub, or when the server's GitHub token can access those repositories.
- Card images may be cached for up to one hour.

## Add a streak card to a README

Replace YOUR_USERNAME:

```markdown
[![GitHub Streak](https://github-streak-bijay-shre-stha.vercel.app/api/streak-image?username=YOUR_USERNAME&theme=radical)](https://github-streak-bijay-shre-stha.vercel.app/YOUR_USERNAME?theme=radical)
```

Themes: default, github, radical, tokyonight, dracula, react.

## API

Limited to 60 requests per minute per IP.

- `GET /api/streak?username=NAME` (optional `variant=extended`): JSON streak stats
- `GET /api/streak-compare?userA=A&userB=B`: JSON comparison of two users
- `GET /api/profile?username=NAME`: JSON public profile
- `GET /api/streak-image?username=NAME` (optional `theme`): SVG card
- `GET /api/streak-stats-image?username=NAME` (optional `theme`): SVG card with extra stats
